title: Corrigendum to the Rules of Procedure of the General Court (OJ L 105, 23.4.2015)
text:
Official Journal of the European Union
EN
L series
24.10.2024
Corrigendum to the Rules of Procedure of the General Court
(
Official Journal of the European Union L 105 of 23 April 2015
)
On page 12, in Article 9(2):
for:
‘If the office of President of the General Court falls vacant before the normal date of expiry of the term thereof, the General Court shall elect a successor for the remainder of the term.’,
read:
‘If the office of President of the General Court falls vacant before the normal date of expiry of the term thereof, he shall be replaced for the remainder of the term.’.
On page 15, in Article 18(5):
for:
‘If the office of the President of a Chamber falls vacant before the normal date of expiry of the term thereof, the Judges shall elect a successor for the remainder of the term.’,
read:
‘If the office of the President of a Chamber falls vacant before the normal date of expiry of the term thereof, he shall be replaced for the remainder of the term.’.
On page 30, in Article 81(1)(b):
for:
‘particulars of the status and address of the applicant’s representative;’,
read:
‘particulars of the status and address of the defendant’s representative;’.
On page 45, in Article 141(1):
for:
‘Sums due from the cashier of the General Court and from its debtors shall be paid in euros.’,
read:
‘Sums due from the cashier of the General Court and from its debtors shall be paid in euro.’.
On page 47, in Article 147(2):
for:
‘The application for legal aid must be made using a form which is published in the Official Journal of the European Union and available on the internet site of the Court of Justice of the European Union.’,
read:
‘The application for legal aid must be made using a form which is published in the Official Journal of the European Union and available on the website of the Court of Justice of the European Union.’.
